name: Turmoil of the Seven
source:
As the Crusade of Man comes to a close, humanity gives birth to a new era, promising the freedoms and rights that were prevalent in the ancient societies of Terra. As the galaxy grows less and less diverse with other aliens species, humanity begins to take its rightful place on the Celestial Throne. However with humanity no longer on the ropes of its demise, the upcoming events will bring forth a conflict of its ancestral past: Without unification against a mutual threat, mankind finds the end to break off their main faction, The Alliance of Free Systems, and create other ones that express different ideologies with various groups of humans scattered across the galaxy. With planets aligning themselves one after another to each of the seven empires, there are not many who can remain neutral to the upcoming conflict. The Turmoil of the Seven Nations.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/530191036/turmoil-of-the-seven-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
随着人类十字军东征接近尾声，人类迎来了新时代，承诺恢复泰拉古代社会曾拥有的自由与权利。随着银河系中的其他外星物种越来越少、种族越来越单一，人类开始登上应得的天界王座。然而，当人类不再濒临灭亡时，接下来的事件将唤起祖先时代的冲突：如果无法团结起来对抗共同威胁，人类将分裂主要派系“自由星系联盟”，建立代表不同意识形态的新派系，散落在银河系各处。各个星球接连加入七大帝国之一，几乎没人能在即将到来的冲突中保持中立。

这就是七国之乱。

[来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/530191036/turmoil-of-the-seven-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
